diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
prevention: Provide adequate water, sunlight, and nutrients

diseases.name: Leaf Blight
symptoms: Brown or black spots on leaves
causes: Fungal infection (often by fungi like Alternaria or Septoria)
prevention: Remove and destroy infected plant material

diseases.name: Leaf Curl
causes: Viral infection, often transmitted by aphids or whiteflies
treatments: No cure for viral infections in plants
Remove and destroy infected plants to prevent spread

diseases.name: Verticillium Wilt
symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of lower leaves
treatments: No cure once plant is infected
Rotate crops and use disease-resistant varieties
prevention: Avoid planting susceptible crops in infected soil

diseases.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
symptoms: Small dark spots with light centers on leaves
causes: Fungal infection caused by Septoria lycopersici
